note: Registry of the mods that ship with the game. "builtin": mods of data/<id>/, part of the game: they live outside mods/ so that players, who only have access to the mods/ folder, cannot delete or replace them. "default" is played when no mod is chosen. The mods of the players are listed in mods/mods.json (folder mods/<id>/); the loaders merge the two lists, built-in mods first. Each mod is described by its mod.json (spec: documentation/mecaniques/pouvoirs-modulaires.md, section 19.3). Atlas Wanderer is itself a mod: the engine (prototype/) holds no game content.
